description: THE MOST IMPORTANT RULE IN THIS FILE. ~45 occurrences of retire-tier words are not vocabulary
at all — they are freshness windows and limitation clauses. 'OIG/LEIE refresh on a monthly
snapshot'. 'Receipt recorded. Does not imply employer acceptance.' A find-and-replace that
strips them would pass a naive gate while deleting the honesty the product is built on.
Where the vocabulary strategy and the truth contract disagree, THE TRUTH CONTRACT WINS.
A segment matching any pattern below is exempt from every vocabulary rule.

acquisition.description: Where a stranger meets VitalCV — homepage, primary nav, onboarding headings, major CTAs, acquisition copy (operating brief). Retire-tier nouns are banned here; allowed deeper.

technicalRegister.description: Explaining the machine is the job of these pages — full internal vocabulary allowed. The inventory lists /trust/* explanatory pages as a legitimate home for 'evidence'. Also covers components/developers/** — SDK documentation, where 'wallet' is the OID4VCI/OID4VP spec term and 'passport' names the actual /api/passport/[npi] path. Spec terms and API names are machine facts, not product vocabulary.

internalOperator.description: Waived entirely — staffed by people who build and run VitalCV. NOT waived: /issuer/*, whose users are credentialing offices, i.e. customers. Also covers components/design-wave1505/** — a design-system reference tree mounted only at /design/wave1505 (layout-gated, 404 in production). Its 'matcha' occurrences name the BRAND COLOUR TOKEN (--matcha-900, 'Matcha is reserved for Recognition moments and primary-button hover'), not the product codename. Token naming is UX-02's contract, not EC-9's. Also covers components/home/w1501/** — the parked wave-1501 homepage era, mounted ONLY at /design/wave1501 (layout-gated, 404 in production). Parked eras are preserved as reference material (PARKED_VISUAL_ERAS.md); rewriting their copy to satisfy current vocabulary rules would falsify the record of what that era said.
